id: \bHalt, Trainer from Pallet! We must battle.

id: \bPerhaps one day we will battle again.
en: \bPerhaps one day we will battle again.

id: \bI was throwing Poké Balls to catch Pokémon, and I ran out.
en: \bI was throwing Poké Balls to catch Pokémon, and I ran out.
it: \bLanciavo Poké Ball per catturare Pokémon e le ho finite.

id: \bThat's why you can never have too many Poké Balls.
en: \bThat's why you can never have too many Poké Balls.
it: \bEcco perché le Poké Ball non bastano mai.

id: \bI came here with some friends to catch us some Bug Pokémon!
en: \bI came here with some friends to catch us some Bug Pokémon!
it: \bSono venuto qui con degli amici a catturare qualche Pokémon di tipo Coleottero!

id: \bThey're all itching to get into some Pokémon battles!
en: \bThey're all itching to get into some Pokémon battles!
it: \bNon vedono l'ora di buttarsi in qualche lotta Pokémon!

id: \bWhat do you call a daredevil Weedle who does stunts on a motorcycle?
en: \bWhat do you call a daredevil Weedle who does stunts on a motorcycle?
it: \bCome si chiama un Weedle spericolato che fa acrobazie in moto?

id: Would you like to take Caterpie with you?
en: Would you like to take Caterpie with you?

id: \bBe quiet. You're scarying the bugs away!
en: \bBe quiet. You're scarying the bugs away!
it: \bFai silenzio. Stai facendo scappare gli insetti!

id: \bShh! You'll scare the bugs away. Another time, okay?
en: \bShh! You'll scare the bugs away. Another time, okay?
it: \bShh! Farai scappare gli insetti. Un'altra volta, va bene?

id: Would you like to take Pidgeotto with you?
en: Would you like to take Pidgeotto with you?

id: \bI may just be a bug catcher, but don't go easy on me.
en: \bI may just be a bug catcher, but don't go easy on me.
it: \bSarò anche solo un Pigliamosche, ma non andarci piano con me.

id: \bThis totally stinks! I'm going to catch some stronger ones!
en: \bThis totally stinks! I'm going to catch some stronger ones!
it: \bChe schifo! Andrò a catturarne di più forti!
